name: Lorna Shore
description: '''Lorna Shore''' is an American [[deathcore]] band formed in [[New Jersey]] in 2009. The group consists of lead guitarist Adam De Micco, drummer Austin Archey, rhythm guitarist Andrew O'Connor, vocalist [[Will Ramos]], and bassist Michael Yager. The band is known for their 2021 single, "To the Hellfire". They have released five studio albums, ''[[Psalms (Lorna Shore album)|Psalms]]'' (2015), ''[[Flesh Coffin]]'' (2017), ''[[Immortal (Lorna Shore album)|Immortal]]'' (2020), ''[[Pain Remains]]'' (2022), and ''[[I Feel the Everblack Festering Within Me]]'' (2025). The band has released four [[Extended play|EP]]s. Since 2012, no original members remain in the band. The longest-running member is Adam De Micco, who joined in 2010.
